item.title: a new cache-mode setting
item.description: GitHub Actions now supports cache-mode, a least-privilege control on the Actions cache aimed at the cache poisoning technique behind recent compromises. (2 sources: nodeweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: compromised TanStack's npm packages in May
item.description: On 2026-05-11, an attacker chained a pull_request_target Pwn Request, GitHub Actions cache poisoning across the fork↔base trust boundary, and OIDC token extraction from runner memory to publish 84 malicious versions across 42 @tanstack/*… (2 sources: nodeweekly, reactstatus)
